messages:
nina: Morning team — thinking about a low-effort recognition push: 'Stamp of Gratitude' desk maildrop. handwritten postcards dropped on desks with a postage stamp and a tiny sticker. low cost, high surprise.
omar: Cute. Logistics questions: do we need HR sign-off for desk mail? any opt-out list?
lucy: Ops note: mailroom can deliver rounds but needs a packing list and labels by Wed EOD. We also need to avoid delivering to contractors who arent on payroll perks list.
nina: Good call. I can pull the current headcount and match against HR roster. We'll only send to full-time + permanent part-time.
mailroom-bot: Heads-up: standard internal drop-off window is 48 hours. For next-week delivery, submit packing manifest and package count 72 hours before drop.
omar: Budget check: 250 postcards (~$45), stamps (250) ~$125, stickers $30, printing & envelopes $20, total ~ $220. Fine?
finance: That budget is fine under Culture small spend. Please code as EVENTS_MAILDROP and attach receipts.
lucy: Volunteers: we need 4 people for a 90-minute stuffing session (addressing/stamping) and 2 people to coordinate with mailroom on the morning run. Can we get volunteers?
nina: I'll take the morning run and one stuffing shift. @omar can you take the second stuffing shift?
omar: Yep I can do a stuffing shift Tue night. Share the template for the postcard copy.
nina: Draft copy idea: "Thanks for the work you do — a small note from a coworker. Want to nominate someone for a bigger shoutout? Visit the recognition page." Keep it short. I'll post a couple micro-variants for tone check.
lucy: For privacy: don't include any manager comments or performance notes on cards. Keep them generic and positive. Also ensure addresses are internal office desks only.
mailroom-bot: ACTION: receive manifest by Tue 5pm to schedule a Wed morning drop.
omar: Will create a small spreadsheet with desk locations + name + package ID. I'll scrub contractors and interns out.
nina: How about an opt-out line in the announcement to #general? "If you'd prefer not to receive physical mail, DM @nina by Tue 4pm."
finance: Also note: if we ship to international offices, customs/ship fees may apply. Are we doing multi-site or single-site pilot?
lucy: Let's pilot in SF office only to keep it simple. If successful, we can plan regional variations.
omar: Volunteer signup idea: 4 slots Tue 6-8pm (addressing) + Wed 7:30-8:30am (hand-off). I'll post a signup form.
nina: I'll prepare the postcard art and two copy options by Monday. If folks approve, we order prints Monday afternoon and plan stuffing Tue night.
lucy: I'll reserve the mailroom timeslot for Wednesday 9am drop. Mailroom needs ~5 cartons labelled.
nina: Checklist in thread: postcard copy (nina), print order (nina after approval), volunteer sheets + manifest (omar), mailroom reservation (lucy), budget approval (finance done). Posting sign-up in 20 min. :mailbox_with_mail:
